_comment: Tank geometry for aquilo_state_local.py. One entry per radar sensor, keyed by the
sensor id the gateway reports in its raw readings (see the README, step 1).
depth_cm: tank depth. Take tank_depth_manual_cm when the vendor panel shows the
depth mode as manual; for auto take the depth it derived (README, step 1).
full_cm: the 'full' offset, the distance from the sensor at which the tank counts
as full (the panel's max level setting).

battery_curve (optional): [[mV, percent], ...] sorted by voltage. Without it a sensor publishes batMv and no battery percentage. The curve here is the one recovered for hardware e19; to fit your own, collect (battery mV, battery_pct) pairs from the vendor's history endpoint before you leave the cloud (README, step 1).
Delete this _comment key if your editor complains; the service ignores it.
